card.name: Spots just before the word eye
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right before a number or noun in eye-related text, where the next word is likely 'eye' or an eye part. Examples are 'pain behind the' and 'at the' in descriptions of the retina.

modes.label: Prepositions before eye
modes.description: Words like 'behind' or 'the' after pain or location words, just before eye or eyeball.

modes.description: A space before a count or dose in eye injury or eye injection text.
